bib.title: Training data-efficient image transformers & distillation through attention

question: Can a convolution-free vision transformer be trained competitively on ImageNet-1k alone, and can a transformer-specific distillation token improve it further?
hypothesis: ViT's need for huge pre-training data can be removed by stronger augmentation/regularisation, and a convnet teacher via a distillation token transfers useful inductive bias.
contributions: Convolution-free transformers competitive with state of the art on ImageNet with no external data, trained on one node (4 GPUs, three days); DeiT-S and DeiT-Ti as counterparts of ResNet-50 and ResNet-18.
Distillation token procedure that outperforms vanilla distillation.
Image transformers learn more from a convnet teacher than from a transformer teacher of comparable accuracy.
Pre-trained DeiT models transfer competitively to CIFAR-10/100, Flowers-102, Cars, iNaturalist-18/19.

method.summary: DeiT keeps the ViT architecture (no convolutions, linear classifier instead of MLP head) and changes the training recipe (AdamW, heavy augmentation, stochastic depth, repeated augmentation, no dropout). It adds a distillation token trained to match a convnet teacher's hard label; at test time class and distillation softmaxes are summed.
method.task: ImageNet-1k image classification, with transfer to smaller datasets

datasets.name: ImageNet Real and ImageNet V2 (matched frequency)
datasets.source: Beyer et al. 2020; Recht et al. 2019

datasets.name: CIFAR-10
datasets.preprocessing: for from-scratch run, images rescaled to 224x224

other.note: trained by the authors with same data and augmentation as DeiT; 82.9 top-1

training.objective: Cross-entropy with label smoothing; hard-label distillation L = 1/2 CE(psi(Zs),y) + 1/2 CE(psi(Zs),yt) with distillation token; soft variant (1-lambda)CE + lambda tau^2 KL
training.lr: 0.0005 x batchsize/512 (cross-validated over 3 rates, printed as 5.10^-4, 3.10^-4, 5.10^-5)
training.epochs: 300 (also 1000 for best results); fine-tuning 25 epochs at 384
training.regularisation: label smoothing 0.1, stochastic depth 0.1, repeated augmentation (3 repetitions), RandAugment 9/0.5, Mixup 0.8, CutMix 1.0, random erasing 0.25, gradient clipping off
training.hardware: single node 8 GPU (V100 16GB per throughput note); 4 GPUs for DeiT-S/Ti
training.compute: inferred: 53 h x 8 GPU for DeiT-B 300 epochs
training.wall_clock: DeiT-B 300 epochs: 53 h on one node or 37 h on 2 nodes; fine-tuning to 384: 20 h on one node; DeiT-S/Ti under 3 days on 4 GPUs
training.seeds: Table 8 baseline reports 81.8 +-0.2 and 83.1 +-0.1; seed count not stated

other.finetune: positional embeddings bicubic-interpolated; AdamW or SGD similar; teacher at target resolution; true label plus teacher prediction
other.ema: EMA gives +0.1 before fine-tuning, vanishes after
other.ViT-B_reference_recipe: batch 4096, lr 0.003, wd 0.3, warmup 3.4 epochs, dropout 0.1 (Table 9)
other.epoch_note: with repeated augmentation 3x, 100 passes counted as 300 epochs (footnote 3)

parameters.fusion: late fusion: sum of softmax outputs of class and distillation heads

metrics.definition: ImageNet validation (also Real, V2), single crop

metrics.name: throughput
metrics.definition: images/s on one 16GB V100, largest batch, mean over 30 runs, timm implementation

metrics.name: decision disagreement
metrics.definition: fraction of samples classified differently between classifier pairs

eval.protocol: Ablations in Table 8 give mean +- on baseline row only; no significance test.

limits: Hyper-parameters in Table 9 may be suboptimal (Table 8 caption); some ablations did not train well (4.3, 3.4 for regularisation rows).
Transformers are sensitive to initialisation and optimiser hyper-parameters; several options did not converge.
DeiT is slightly below EfficientNet in accuracy/throughput without distillation.
Gains from the distillation token over class token are small (about 0.1-0.3 points); authors say the explanation (inductive bias from convnet) is not formally established.
Number of seeds, mixed-precision use and exact GPU model for training not stated; single-crop eval only.
Best 85.2 requires 1000 epochs and a convnet teacher trained by the authors.

terms.definition: a learned token added alongside class and patch tokens that interacts via self-attention and whose output is trained to reproduce the (hard) label of the teacher
the teacher's argmax decision is used as a true label, loss 1/2 CE(true) + 1/2 CE(teacher)
each image repeated in a batch with different augmentations (3 repetitions), so one epoch sees a third of the images
